title: Undernourishment, 1970-2015
book_page: Supplemental Graphics PDF page 6 / book page 72
claim_summary: The share of people in developing countries who are undernourished declined from 1970 to 2015.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser 2016j, based on data from the Food and Agriculture Organization 2014, also reported in FAOSTAT.
visual_validation: partial; all named regional curves now recovered for 1991-2015 from archived FAO workbook, with source-vintage caveat
editorial_remediation_decision: Retain partial_match; raise confidence to medium after archived FAO regional workbook recovery, but do not mark verified.
notes: Archived FAO Food Security Indicators workbooks were recovered from the book-cited FAO page. March 17, 2016 workbook sheet V_2.6 supplies named regional series from 1991-2015; the recovered November 2014 workbook documents the source family but does not extend to the 2015 endpoint.
